# Aspen Montessori School

> A nurturing, child-led Montessori school serving children ages 12 months to 5 years in Bothell and Kenmore, Washington.

## About

Aspen Montessori School provides authentic Montessori education in a warm, prepared environment. We follow Maria Montessori's philosophy — children learn at their own pace through hands-on materials, freedom of choice, and a caring community of educators.

## Campuses

- **Bothell Campus** — 4024 222nd Pl SE, Bothell, WA 98021 | Mon–Fri, 8:45 am – 4:45 pm
- **Kenmore Campus** — 17605 80th CT NE, Kenmore, WA 98028 | Mon–Fri, 7:30 am – 5:30 pm

## Programs

- Infant & Toddler (12 months – 3 years)
- Primary (3 – 5 years)
- Child-led, play-based, Montessori curriculum
- Small class sizes with experienced educators
- Enrollment now open for Kenmore Campus

## Hiring & Careers

Aspen Montessori School is actively hiring at both campuses. Full careers page: https://www.aspenmontessorischool.com/careers.html

HR contact: aspenmontessorihr@gmail.com

### Open Positions

**Lead Montessori Guide** (Full-Time) — Bothell &amp; Kenmore campuses
- Deliver authentic Montessori curriculum for toddler and primary classrooms (ages 12 months – 5 years)
- Observe and document each child's learning journey; communicate with families
- AMI/AMS Montessori credential preferred (or in progress)

**Assistant Montessori Guide** (Full-Time / Part-Time) — Bothell &amp; Kenmore campuses
- Support Lead Guide in daily classroom activities and lessons
- Training provided; passion for early childhood education required

**Classroom Floater / Substitute** (Part-Time) — Bothell &amp; Kenmore campuses
- Flexible coverage across classrooms; great entry point into Montessori education

**School Office Administrator** (Full-Time) — Bothell Campus
- Front-desk operations, enrollment inquiries, scheduling, and school communications
- Strong organizational skills required; office or school experience preferred

### Benefits
- Competitive pay and paid time off
- Ongoing Montessori training and professional development
- Supportive, collaborative team environment

### How to Apply
Email your resume and cover letter to aspenmontessorihr@gmail.com with the role title in the subject line.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What ages do you serve?**
Children ages 12 months to 5 years.

**Where are your campuses?**
We have two campuses — 4024 222nd Pl SE, Bothell, WA 98021 and 17605 80th CT NE, Kenmore, WA 98028.

**What are your hours?**
Bothell: Monday–Friday, 8:45 am – 4:45 pm. Kenmore: Monday–Friday, 7:30 am – 5:30 pm.

**What is Montessori education?**
Montessori is a child-centered educational approach developed by Dr. Maria Montessori. Children choose their work freely, learn through hands-on materials, and develop independence, focus, and intrinsic motivation.

**How do I enroll?**
Email us at aspenmontessorischool@gmail.com or call 425-318-9956 to schedule a tour.

**Is Aspen Montessori now enrolling?**
Yes — enrollment is open for both campuses, including the new Kenmore Campus.
